fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $55,000, paid in a lump sum at signing and is nonrefundable. Discounts available: 5% for Industry Experience, 20% for Military, 15% for Affiliate, 15% for Conversion Franchise. Only one discount may be used. Incentives (cash, equipment, materials, supplies) may also be offered that effectively lower the fee. In 2024, actual Initial Franchise Fees collected ranged from $18,750 to $49,500.
raw_excerpt: If you purchase a Franchised Business, you must pay us an initial franchise fee equal to $55,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") upon execution of the Franchise Agreement. ... In 2024, the Initial Franchise Fees we collected for Franchised Businesses ranged from $18,750 to $49,500.
